name: WebView universal/file URL access enabled
attack_scenario: Attacker gets the app to render a malicious local HTML file; its JavaScript uses XMLHttpRequest on file:///data/data/<pkg>/... to read the auth database and POST it to a remote server.
negative_test_hint: render a malicious local HTML file whose script reads "file:///data/data/com.example.app/databases/auth.db" via XMLHttpRequest and assert the WebView blocks the cross-origin file read

exemplar.compliant:
webView.settings.allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs = false
webView.settings.allowFileAccessFromFileURLs = false
webView.settings.allowFileAccess = false
// Serve local assets through WebViewAssetLoader over https instead of file://
exemplar.explanation: setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs/setAllowFileAccessFromFileURLs let content loaded from a file:// URL read arbitrary local files and make cross-origin requests, defeating the same-origin policy. Combined with any injected JS (e.g. a saved HTML file or downloaded content), it enables theft of the app's private files. OWASP MASVS-PLATFORM; Google explicitly deprecated these flags for this reason.
